_note: WHAT gecko-clipboard.mjs EXPECTS FROM FIREFOX, one row per image size, and the suite fails on any row
whose observed outcome differs. An outcome is 'ok' (the PNG read back at the size written),
'refused' (navigator.clipboard.write rejected; the error text is printed) or 'unverified' (the
write resolved and the read-back did not return that image).
WRITTEN 2026-09-24 WITHOUT A FIREFOX: the draft sandbox had none, so every row below is the
HYPOTHESIS (the shipped manifest's copy works in Firefox without clipboardWrite, inside a user
gesture), not a measurement, and `measured` is null to say so. The first e2e-suite run on the
runner's Firefox measures it; its outcome per size, its click-to-write ms and the run id go into
`measured` and into AI-HANDOFF-ENVELOPE.md section 13, and a row that differs is corrected HERE, in
the same commit, with the engine, version and error text beside it.
If a row measures 'refused' without clipboardWrite: the standing ruling is to add clipboardWrite
for that engine only, with a store justification line, unless that raises a new install-time
warning on an already published listing.
MEASURED 2026-09-25 (filled 2026-09-29, rv2 EXB-10): Extensions run 36186697794, ubuntu-24.04, /usr/bin/firefox
Mozilla Firefox 156.0, HEADFUL under xvfb-run, the shipped permissions (no clipboardWrite): all three
image-only rows came back ok, at the size written — 256x256 15 ms, 1920x1080 46 ms, 1920x10000 402 ms
click-to-write. The hypothesis held; no row was corrected.
ADDED 2026-09-29 (rv2 EXB-10): the TWO-TYPE row. result.js copies the AI hand-off as ONE ClipboardItem
holding image/png AND text/plain (fsCopyBlobToClipboard(blob, fit, text)); the image-only rows above never
graded that write in Firefox. The row carries `text`, and it is ok only when BOTH types read back and the
text is byte-identical. Its expectation is the HYPOTHESIS until the next e2e-suite run measures it;
`measured.twoType` stays null until then. Red control: drop the text/plain member in
fsCopyBlobToClipboard -> the row reads back image/png alone -> unverified -> exit 1.
